label: PF Backlog 550
title: C18: PF security plan/guidelines SSOT (global, enforceable) - for PF itself and its agents
body:
## Problem / why
`docs/SECURITY-ARCHITECTURE-CISO.md` (C1) is PF's POSTURE NARRATIVE (audience: humans/CISO). There is no
machine-enforceable security plan/guidelines an agent/gate can read and apply.

## Goal & value
ONE PF-level security plan/guidelines SSOT that governs **PF itself and its agents** (the enforcing plane).
The generated product gets its OWN plan/guidelines, DERIVED from this SSOT + the product's capabilities (C13),
never hand-written and never a copy.

## In scope
- `config/security-guidelines.json` (SSOT, kind=config, scope=global): controls per capability (LLM, RAG, agents,
  tools, external APIs, sensitive data, code-exec, browser, memory, delegation, autonomous), each mapped to the
  S0-S6 gate that enforces it (C14) and a risk tier; rules PF's own agents must obey.
- `docs/SECURITY-GUIDELINES.md` human narrative that REFERENCES the config (no second truth).
- Loader `core/security_guidelines.py:load()` with sane defaults when missing; registered in store-registry.
- CISO doc cross-links the SSOT (posture vs policy separation, one truth per concern).

## Out of scope
- The GENERATED per-product security plan/guidelines + profile/manifest (C13 = BI-PF-1215) and the gates'
  enforcement code (C14 = BI-PF-1216).

## Acceptance criteria (G/W/T)
- Given the PF guidelines config, when a capability is enabled for a product, then the product's generated
  plan/guidelines (C13) is produced from it (guidelines x capabilities).
- Given PF's own agents, then they read/obey this same SSOT (not a copied doc).

## Data model (what is stored, where, owner)
`config/security-guidelines.json` -> owner `core/security_guidelines.py` (single writer). Per-product output is
C13's derived store.

## Dependencies & links (by id)
C13 BI-PF-1215 (generates the product's own plan/guidelines from this), C14 BI-PF-1216 (gates cite controls),
C1 BI-PF-1203 (posture doc links it).

## Verification / test plan
Unit: load() defaults + schema; guideline->control->gate mapping completeness; no drift vs register.
